bookTitle: Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives (John C. Hull)
generalAssumptions: Plain vanilla interest rate swaps involve exchange of fixed for floating payments on a notional principal.
Notional principal is never exchanged at any point in an interest rate swap.
The swap rate is chosen at contract inception so that the initial net present value of the swap is zero.
Credit risk in interest rate swaps represents bilateral replacement cost, governed post-2008 by CCP central clearing.

facts.topic: Mechanics of Plain Vanilla Interest Rate Swaps
facts.statement: An interest rate swap is an agreement between two counterparties to exchange interest rate cash flows on a specified notional principal without exchanging the principal itself. Party A agrees to pay fixed interest payments and receive floating interest payments (referencing 6-month SOFR or LIBOR). Net payment = (Floating Rate - Fixed Rate) * Notional * (Days / 360).

facts.topic: Transforming Liabilities: Floating Debt to Fixed Debt
facts.statement: A company with floating-rate debt (e.g. paying SOFR + 1.0% to a bank) can enter an interest rate swap paying fixed 5.0% and receiving SOFR. The received SOFR exactly offsets the floating loan benchmark, transforming borrowing costs into a synthetically locked fixed rate of 6.0% (5.0% fixed swap + 1.0% bank spread).

sourceCitation.section: 7.2 Using Swaps to Transform Liabilities and Assets

variables.definition: Effective synthetic fixed interest cost

facts.topic: Transforming Assets: Fixed Investments to Floating Returns
facts.statement: An institutional investor holding a 6.0% fixed-rate bond enters a swap paying fixed 5.0% and receiving SOFR. The net asset return becomes SOFR + 1.0% (6.0% bond coupon - 5.0% fixed swap + SOFR), transforming a fixed investment into a floating asset and immunizing portfolio value against interest rate hikes.

sourceCitation.section: 7.2 Using Swaps to Transform Liabilities and Assets

facts.topic: Financial Intermediary Role and Bid-Offer Spreads
facts.statement: Financial institutions act as market-making swap banks between fixed payers and floating payers. A swap bank quotes a bid-ask spread (e.g. 4.98% bid vs 5.02% ask against floating SOFR), earning 4 basis points ($40,000 per year per $100M notional) completely insulated from directional interest rate movements.

numericalDetails.context: Swap bank matched book earning 4 bps bid-offer spread on $100M notional

facts.statement: When credit spread differentials differ between fixed and floating debt markets, a swap unlocks mutual arbitrage gains: Total Gain = (Fixed Spread Difference) - (Floating Spread Difference). E.g., if AAA Firm A borrows fixed at 10.0% and floating at SOFR+0.3%, while BBB Firm B borrows fixed at 11.2% and floating at SOFR+1.0%, the fixed spread differential is 1.2% and floating is 0.7%, unlocking 50 bps total arbitrage surplus.

variables.definition: Combined arbitrage savings available to counterparties
Difference between Firm B and Firm A fixed borrowing rates
Difference between Firm B and Firm A floating borrowing spreads

facts.topic: Valuation of Interest Rate Swaps via Forward Rates and OIS Discounting
facts.statement: A swap is calibrated to have zero market value at inception. As benchmark rates shift, swap value to the floating receiver equals the sum of discounted cash flows where floating payments are determined by forward rates F_i and discounted using OIS zero discount factors P(0, t_i): V_swap = sum((F_i - K) * Delta t * P(0, t_i)).

variables.definition: Net present value of swap to floating receiver
Forward interest rate for period i
Contractual fixed swap rate
OIS risk-free discount factor to cash flow date t_i

facts.topic: Bond Portfolio Decomposition of an Interest Rate Swap
facts.statement: An interest rate swap paying fixed and receiving floating can be decomposed into an equivalent long position in a floating-rate bond and a short position in a fixed-rate bond: V_swap = B_fl - B_fix. Immediately after each payment date, the floating-rate bond resets exactly to par ($100M), simplifying ongoing revaluation.

sourceCitation.section: 7.6 Valuation in Terms of Bond Prices

facts.topic: Credit Risk, Bilateral Replacement Cost, and CCP Clearing
facts.statement: Counterparty credit risk in interest rate swaps is strictly bilateral replacement cost: max(0, V_swap). Notional principal is never at risk. Post-2008 regulatory reforms mandate that standardized plain vanilla interest rate swaps be cleared through Central Counterparties (CCPs) with daily variation margin and multilateral netting, virtually eliminating systemic counterparty default contagion.
